{{Top|leg}}
A '''bantha rush''' was an [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]] technique where an attacker would charge an opponent and attempt to push the individual backwards instead of injuring them.<ref name="RCR">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
